# README graphics

Every graphic in the README is an SVG generated by the scripts here. They need Node 18 or later and have no dependencies. The kit is based on the generator in [janiyax35/janiyax35](https://github.com/janiyax35/janiyax35/tree/main/scripts). GitHub Pages skips the `.github` folder, so none of this is published on the site.

| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `content.mjs` | All the text in the graphics. Edit this first. |
| `build.mjs` | Draws everything into `assets/`. |
| `lib.mjs` | Shared palette, embedded fonts and animation helpers. Copied unchanged from the profile repo. |
| `fonts/` | JetBrains Mono and Space Grotesk, cut down to ASCII plus `· – — ’ …` (OFL-1.1, licences included). |
| `preview.html` | Local preview of the README with light/dark, replay and phone-width buttons. |
| `assets/` | Generated SVGs, plus the two screenshots (`screen-*.png`). |

```bash
node .github/readme/build.mjs      # redraw assets/*.svg
python -m http.server 8091         # from the repo root, then open:
# http://127.0.0.1:8091/.github/readme/preview.html
```

**Screenshots** aren't generated. To retake them, serve the site on port 8080 and run headless Chrome with reduced motion, which skips the boot screen:

```bash
chrome --headless=new --hide-scrollbars --force-prefers-reduced-motion --window-size=1280,800 \
  --virtual-time-budget=8000 --screenshot=screen-home.png http://localhost:8080/index.html
```

**Animation rule:** an element's normal style is its final state, and keyframes animate from the hidden state with `fill-mode: both`. With reduced motion on, every SVG still shows all of its content. Use CSS animations only, not SMIL.
